quote: The game mechanics are stolen from Red Dead Redemption 2. This does not play like a GTA game at all. The freedom of previous GTA releases are all gone in an attempt to be politically correct. What do you mean I cannot steal a car in certain zones? Who wants to paint walls in a game... seriously... rockstar has dropped the ball and made a game for simps
